original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚参议院呼吁紧急拨款并强制筛查以应对埃博拉
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚参议院周三通过动议，敦促联邦政府从服务范围拨款中拨出紧急资金应对埃博拉疫情，并防止其进一步扩散。动议还要求在国际机场、海港和指定陆路口岸实施强制性健康筛查，包括健康申报表、体温检测和症状筛查。参议员提及刚果（金）据报出现埃博拉疫情并扩散至其他国家，参议院议长对一名旅客未经充分筛查入境表示担忧。

location.raw_text: Nigeria's international airports, seaports and designated land borders

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚参议院通过动议，敦促联邦政府从服务范围拨款中拨出紧急资金应对埃博拉疫情
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Senate on Wednesday urged the federal government to release emergency funds from the Service-Wide Vote to tackle the Ebola outbreak and prevent further spread.

key_facts.fact: 动议要求在国际机场、海港和指定陆路口岸实施强制性健康筛查
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: mandatory health screening at Nigeria’s international airports, seaports and designated land borders

key_facts.fact: 参议员称刚果（金）据报出现埃博拉疫情并已扩散至其他国家
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Faduyile said the reported outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and its spread to other countries required immediate preventive measures.

key_facts.fact: 参议院议长对一名旅客未经充分筛查入境表示担忧
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Senate President Godswill Akpabio expressed concern over reports that a traveller who entered Nigeria without adequate screening at the point of arrival.

uncertainties: 刚果（金）埃博拉疫情及扩散情况为参议员引述的报道，尚未在文中获得独立确认
旅客未经充分筛查入境的具体情况尚未证实
